  • 英語名: Setsuna ni Kakeru Koi Hanabi

别名

  • Kakehana

あらすじ

In the 2040s in Japan, the near-future sport “Jindou” boasts a high popularity as the sport of the people. And the the most famous of all the Jindou performances is the “Daihouen”.

Suzakuin Nadeshiko, although currently still a school student, has been fantastically making a name for herself as a pro swordswoman. On the other side, the protagonist Takizawa Kazuma, a washed-up pro swordsman, competes in underground Jindou matches to make ends meet.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 日本語名: 旭とワンルーム 〜とある夏の一日〜
  • 英語名: Asahi to One Room Toaru Natsu no Ichinichi

あらすじ

One day during the summer holidays, while all the other dorm residents headed back to their family’s homes, the members of the Takamura class were enjoying the remainder of their holiday to the max at the academy.

Asahi has completely become a commuting wife with how she regularly heads to Iori’s room without worrying about those around her. However, she’s seeming a bit overworked after the Enbu-sai. Deciding that things can’t go on like this, Iori makes a certain suggestion to her on a day where the other members of the Takamura class aren’t around.

あらすじ

One day during the summer holidays, while all the other dorm residents headed back to their family’s homes, the members of the Takamura class were enjoying the remainder of their holiday to the max at the academy.

During this time, Momiji realises that there just happens to be a day where everyone else is out of the dorm apart from her. Thinking that she could have Iori all to herself, without having to worry about the gazes of the others, she barged into Iori’s room.

item.title: Akatsuki Yureru Koi Akari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CRYSTALiA
  • 発売日: 2020-12-25
  • スコア: 7.82/10 (276 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 紅月ゆれる恋あかり
  • 英語名: Akatsuki Yureru Koi Akari

别名

  • ゆれあか

あらすじ

“Jindou” it’s a near-future sport where you fight with real swords that’s really hot in Japan in the 2040s. Two girls enrolled into Murakumo Academy where said Jindou is taught. One of them is Kazamine Setsugekka, a rough and emotionally-driven girl who bolsters her blade with the unparalleled strength within her. The other is Suzakuin Momiji, a cool headed and incredibly precise girl with a prodigious sense for swordplay and a frightening sharp mind. These two, whose circumstances and personalities are completely different, both aim for the the title conferred upon the strongest in the academy, the “Toujinegi”.

item.title: Shiraha Kirameku Koi Shirabe
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CRYSTALiA
  • 発売日: 2019-11-29
  • スコア: 6.640000000000001/10 (129 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 白刃きらめく恋しらべ
  • 英語名: Shiraha Kirameku Koi Shirabe

别名

  • めくらべ

あらすじ

Ayato is an exorcist who works for the government. This time his mission is to investigate and destroy a supernatural object which had been brought into the sword arts school Murakumo Gakuen. With the help of his team members Hime and Ruri, he traced its location to Matsurika, the sole daughter of the head of the Swordbearing Defence Group. They were successful in destroying the object, but as a result, Matsurika became the initiator of the Spiritual Calamity. To teach her skills to fight against spirits, Ayato became a temporary mentor to her.

あらすじ

Touki is a second-year student at Murakumo Academy who is training as a katana smith. He attracts a lot of attention since his ancestor was a famous katana smith, but due to a certain reason, he spent all his time playing with machines instead.

The appearance one day of the ‘goddess’ Ayase, who claimed to be the guardian deity of his family home, was the trigger for many fated meetings:
